description: This Java source file defines the VariableRegistry class, which manages variable definitions, substitutions, and code generation for a configuration system, likely related to automotive or embedded systems configuration.

classes.name: VariableRegistry
classes.description: A singleton class extending TreeMap to store variable names and values, facilitating variable substitution, registration, and code generation for configuration constants.

methods.name: applyVariables
methods.description: Replaces variable references in a string with their registered values, supporting @@var@@ syntax.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a variable with a string or integer value, and updates internal representations and code snippets.

methods.name: tryToRegisterAsInteger
methods.description: Attempts to parse and register a variable as an integer constant or as a string if parsing fails.

methods.name: isQuoted
methods.description: Checks if a string value is quoted, indicating a string literal.

methods.name: writeNumericsToFile
methods.description: Outputs the registered numeric definitions into a header file for C/C++ code.

methods.name: getJavaConstants
methods.description: Returns a concatenation of Java static final constants definitions for all registered variables.
